extracted.name: Kiwi Strawberry Smoothie
extracted.description: This kiwi strawberry smoothie is easy to make with pineapple and orange juice, vanilla frozen yogurt, and banana for a tropical, fruity quencher.
ingredient_lines: 0.75 cup pineapple and orange juice blend
instruction_lines: Place juice blend, frozen yogurt, banana, strawberries, and kiwi into a blender. Blend until smooth and pour into 2 glasses.
